Glory be to Allah
All praise be to Allah
There is no god but Allah
Allah is the Greatest

Translation: There is no power or strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ
Translation: Glory be to Allah during the night and at the ends of the day
Glory be to Allah in the morning and the evening
Glory be to Allah in the evening and the morning

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
Translation: Glory be to Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning
And to Him is all praise in the heavens and the earth
In the evening and when you are at midday
He brings forth the living from the dead
And brings forth the dead from the living
And He gives life to the earth after its death
And likewise you will be brought forth

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
Translation: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe
And peace be upon the Messengers

Glory be to the Owner of the Kingdom and Sovereignty
Glory be to the Owner of Honor and Might
Glory be to the Owner of Greatness and Magnificence
The True King, the Guardian, the Manifest, the Holy

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْمَلِكِ الْحَيِّ الَّذِيْ لَايَمُوتُ
Translation: Glory be to Allah, the Living King who never dies
Glory be to Allah, the Living King, the Holy
Glory be to the Ever-Standing, the Everlasting
Glory be to the Everlasting, the Ever-Standing
Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent
Glory be to my Lord, the Most High
Glory be to the Living, the Self-Subsisting
Glory be to the Most High, the Exalted
Glory be to Him and Exalted is He
The Perfect, the Holy
Our Lord and the Lord of the angels and the Spirit
Glory be to the Everlasting who is never heedless
Glory be to the Knower who needs no teaching

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ خَالِقِ مَا يُرىٰ وَمَا لَايُرىٰ
Translation: Glory be to the Creator of what is seen and what is unseen
Glory be to the One who perceives all vision
But vision cannot perceive Him
And He is the Subtle, the All-Aware

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِيْ نِعْمَةٍ وَخَيْرٍ
Translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning in Your blessing and goodness
And bounty and well-being
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And complete Your blessing and goodness upon me
And Your bounties and Your well-being
With salvation from the Fire
And grant me gratitude for You and Your well-being
And Your grace and Your honor, forever, as long as You keep me alive
O Allah, by Your light I am guided
And by Your grace I am enriched
And by Your blessing I enter the morning and the evening

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ وَكَفىٰ بِكَ شَهِيدًا
Translation: O Allah, I call You to witness, and sufficient are You as a witness
And I call to witness Your angels, Your prophets, and Your messengers
And the bearers of Your Throne, and the inhabitants of Your heavens and earth
And all Your creation

Arabic text: بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَاإِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: That You are Allah, there is no god but You
Alone, without any partner

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
Translation: And that Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, is Your servant and messenger
And that You have power over all things
You give life and cause death, and cause death and give life
And I bear witness that Paradise is true
And that Hellfire is true
And resurrection is true
And the Hour is coming, there is no doubt about it

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِيْ الْقُبُورِ
Translation: And that Allah will resurrect those in the graves

Arabic text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِيْ طَالِبٍ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَقًّا حَقًّا
Translation: And I bear witness that Ali ibn Abi Talib is truly the Commander of the Faithful, truly, truly

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ الْهُدَاةُ الْمَهْدِيُّونَ
Translation: And that the Imams from his descendants are the guiding Imams, the guided ones
Neither astray nor leading others astray
And that they are Your chosen guardians
And Your victorious party
And Your chosen ones and Your best from Your creation
And Your distinguished ones whom You have selected for Your religion
And have chosen them from Your creation
And selected them over Your servants
And made them a proof for the worlds

Arabic text: صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَالسَّلامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
Translation: Your blessings upon them, and peace, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِيْ هٰذِهِ الشَّهَادَةَ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: O Allah, record this testimony for me with You

Arabic text: حَتّىٰ تُلَقِّنَنِيهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَنْتَ عَنِّيْ رَاضٍ
Translation: So that You may remind me of it on the Day of Resurrection, while You are pleased with me
Verily, You have power over whatever You will

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يَصْعَدُ أَوَّلُهُ وَلَا يَنْفَدُ آخِرُهُ
Translation: O Allah, all praise be to You, praise whose beginning ascends but whose end never depletes

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا تَضَعُ لَكَ السَّمَاءُ كَنَفَيْهَا
Translation: O Allah, to You is all praise, praise for which the heavens lower their sides
And the earth and all upon it glorify You

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا سَرْمَدًا أَبَدًا
Translation: O Allah, to You is all praise, eternal and everlasting praise
With no interruption and no end
And it is fitting for You and ends with You
In me and upon me and with me
And with me and before me and after me
And in front of me and above me and beneath me

Arabic text: وَإِذَا مِتُّ وَبَقِيتُ فَرْدًا وَحِيدًا ثُمَّ فَنِيتُ
Translation: And when I die and remain alone and isolated, then perish
And to You is all praise when I am resurrected and raised
O my Master

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ بِجَمِيعِ مَحَامِدِكَ كُلِّهَا
Translation: O Allah, to You is all praise and to You is all thanks with all of Your praises
For all of Your blessings

Arabic text: حَتَّىٰ يَنْتَهِيَ الْحَمْدُ إِلَى مَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضىٰ
Translation: Until praise reaches what You love, our Lord, and what pleases You

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَكْلَةٍ وَشَرْبَةٍ
Translation: O Allah, to You is all praise for every morsel and drink
And grasp and grip
And extension and in every place of a hair

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا خَالِدًا مَعَ خُلُودِكَ
Translation: O Allah, to You is all praise, praise lasting with Your eternity

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَامُنْتَهىٰ لَهُ دُوْنَ عِلْمِكَ
Translation: And to You is all praise, praise that has no end short of Your knowledge

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَاأَمَدَ لَهُ دُوْنَ مَشِيَّتِكَ
Translation: And to You is all praise, praise that has no limit short of Your will

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَا أَجْرَ لِقَائِلِهِ إِلَّا رِضَاكَ
Translation: And to You is all praise, praise for which its speaker has no reward except Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حِلْمِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ
Translation: And to You is all praise for Your forbearance after Your knowledge

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى عَفْوِكَ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِكَ
Translation: And to You is all praise for Your pardon after Your power
And to You is all praise, O Initiator of praise
And to You is all praise, O Inheritor of praise
And to You is all praise, O Originator of praise
And to You is all praise, O Ultimate End of praise
And to You is all praise, O Innovator of praise
And to You is all praise, O Purchaser of praise
And to You is all praise, O Guardian of praise
And to You is all praise, O Ancient of praise

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَفِيَّ الْعَهْدِ
Translation: And to You is all praise, O True to the Promise, Faithful to the Covenant
Mighty in armies, Perpetual in glory

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ رَفِيعَ الدَّرَجَاتِ مُجِيبَ الدَّعَوَاتِ
Translation: And to You is all praise, O Raiser of ranks, Answerer of prayers

Arabic text: مُنْزِلَ الْآيَاتِ مِنْ فَوْقِ سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتٍ
Translation: Revealer of verses from above the seven heavens
Great in blessings
Bringer of light from darkness

Arabic text: وَمُخْرِجَ مَنْ فِيْ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
Translation: And Bringer of those in darkness to light
Transformer of evil deeds into good deeds
And Maker of good deeds into degrees of elevation

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ غَافِرَ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلَ التَّوْبِ
Translation: O Allah, to You is all praise, O Forgiver of sin, Acceptor of repentance
Severe in punishment, Possessor of bounty
There is no god but You, to You is the final return

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِيْ اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشىٰ
Translation: O Allah, to You is all praise in the night when it covers

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِيْ النَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلّىٰ
Translation: And to You is all praise in the day when it appears
And to You is all praise in the Hereafter and the first life

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ كُلِّ نَجْمٍ وَمَلَكٍ فِيْ السَّمَاءِ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the number of every star and angel in the sky

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ الثَّرَىٰ وَالْحَصىٰ وَالنَّوَىٰ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the number of soil particles, pebbles and date seeds

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا فِيْ جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the number of what is in the atmosphere of the sky

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا فِيْ جَوْفِ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the number of what is in the depths of the earth

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ أَوْزَانِ مِيَاهِ الْبِحَارِ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the weight of the waters of the seas
And to You is all praise to the number of the leaves of the trees

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا عَلَى وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the number of what is on the face of the earth

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصىٰ كِتَابُكَ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the number of what Your Book has enumerated

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
Translation: And to You is all praise to the number of what Your knowledge encompasses
And to You is all praise to the number of humans and jinn
And insects, birds, beasts, and predators
Abundant, good praise

Arabic text: مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ كَمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضىٰ
Translation: Blessed as You love, our Lord, and as pleases You

Arabic text: وَكَمَا يَنْبَغِيْ لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ وَعِزِّ جَلالِكَ
Translation: And as befits the generosity of Your face and the might of Your majesty

Arabic text: لَاإِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَاشَرِيكَ لَهُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, alone with no partner
To Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs all praise
And He is the Subtle, the All-Aware

Arabic text: لَاإِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَاشَرِيكَ لَهُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, alone with no partner
To Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs all praise

Arabic text: يُحْيِيْ وَيُمِيتُ، وَيُمِيتُ وَيُحْيِيْ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَايَمُوتُ
Translation: He gives life and causes death, and causes death and gives life, and He is Living and never dies

Arabic text: بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: In His hand is all good and He has power over all things

Arabic text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ لَاإِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides whom there is no god, the Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him in repentance
O Allah, O Allah
O Most Gracious, O Most Gracious
O Most Merciful, O Most Merciful
O Originator of the heavens and the earth
O Lord of Majesty and Honor

O Living, O Self-Subsisting

Arabic text: يَا حَيُّ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: O Allah, O There is no god but You
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ افْعَلْ بِيْ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
Translation: O Allah, do with me as You are worthy of doing
Amen, Amen
Say: He is Allah, the One

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اصْنَعْ بِيْ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
Translation: O Allah, treat me as You are worthy of treating

Arabic text: وَلَا تَصْنَعْ بِيْ مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
Translation: And do not treat me as I am worthy of being treated
For You are worthy of piety and worthy of forgiveness
And I am worthy of sins and mistakes
So have mercy on me, O my Master
And You are the Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
Translation: There is no power or strength except with Allah
I rely on the Living who never dies

Arabic text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا
Translation: And all praise be to Allah who has not taken a son

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِيْ الْمُلْكِ
Translation: And has no partner in His dominion

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَ لِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ
Translation: And has no protector out of weakness
And magnify Him with glorification
